files_actually_read.semantics: top-k encoder scores choose content/features and reference logits; encoder boxes are sigmoid before DN concatenation; training detaches reference logits and non-learned normal contents before DN embeddings concatenate; decoder receives full DN+normal logits.
files_actually_read.rcsq_difference: RCS-Q preserves native selection and detach sequence, then adds query-local support from original Neck P3 before decoder. It does not replace top-k or import this alternate Ultralytics tree.

files_actually_read.semantics: Learned query-conditioned offsets and weights over levels/points; 2D references normalize offsets by W,H, 4D references scale offsets by box width/height divided by n_points and multiplied by 0.5.
files_actually_read.rcsq_difference: RCS-Q has fixed 5x5 bin centers, one P3 map, two support heads and zero-value null slot. No learned sampling offsets or replacement of native MSDeformAttn.

files_actually_read.semantics: Pixel centers arange(H/W)+0.5, coordinate order x,y, normalizer W,H, normalized coordinates 2*(coords+offset)/normalizer-1, bilinear grid_sample align_corners=False padding_mode=border.
files_actually_read.rcsq_difference: Only sampling coordinate/interpolation conventions are borrowed. RCS-Q uses per-box normalized bin centers and explicit true image-bound masks, not learned upsampling offsets, pixel shuffle, or extra_modules imports. meshgrid indexing is explicit in RCS-Q.

research_attribution.title: Enhancing DETR’s Variants through Improved Content Query and Similar Query Aggregation
research_attribution.attribution: SACQ already studies content-query enhancement through global self-attention pooling and later local ROI features; associated QA aggregates similar predictions before matching. RCS-Q tests centered local value evidence plus a zero-value null slot at initialization, retains the native query and matching, and makes no claim to first content enhancement or first region sampling.

original_cbr_difference: Original CBR acts after decoder with final query/final boxes and 36 four-edge inside/outside points. RCS-Q acts before decoder on 25 within-region points with region-mean-centered values. CBR math and its state_dict member cbr are retained.
